result: All three suitable for concept review; no visual blocker at full size and 96px light/dark composites.
findings: Dragon: broad wings, long tail and four-legged body remain readable.
Demon: tall crown, sword and claw silhouette; gold trims and overlapping wings/arms become busy at 96px.
Cyclops: exactly one visible eye, organic skin, massive hammer; eye becomes tiny at 96px.
All preserve serious angular Runelord cel shading.
Backgrounds composite cleanly. Raw image preview haze is not evidence of cutout failure; dominant foreground alpha is 253/255.
limitations: Flattened single-pose artwork, not separated layers or completed rigs.
Embedded fire details require planning for animation.
No runtime size or gameplay implementation verified.

construction.dragon: Proposed: chest/pelvis, head/jaw and neck chain, four upper/lower leg pairs with paws, wing roots/spans, segmented tail, throat VFX.
construction.demon: Proposed: pelvis/torso/head, paired arms/legs, claw hands/feet, independent sword at hand grip, wings and crown fire.
construction.cyclops: Proposed: torso/pelvis/head/jaw, paired limbs, overlapping shoulder/hip armor, independent maul at grip, crest/eye VFX.

conditionalStates: Cast, guard and spawn applicability unresolved until gameplay specification; no raised/tamed forms assumed.
